description: Light manufacturing district. Permits manufacturing, commercial, and some community facility uses. Residential use generally prohibited (except M1-1D suffix with special authorization). No front or side yard requirements.

bulk.far_commercial: 1.0 to 10.0 depending on special district; no fixed FAR in underlying M1-1
bulk.far_note: FAR in M1 districts varies. Sky exposure plane governs height. No fixed residential FAR — residential not permitted.

height_setback.community_facility_max_front_wall: 35 ft or 3 stories, whichever is less, per §43-41
height_setback.notes: Sky exposure plane governs. Buildings below max front wall height do not require setback. Community facility buildings max front wall 35 ft / 3 stories in M1-1 per §43-41. No front or side yard required in M districts.
height_setback.tower_permitted: Yes, towers permitted in M1-3 through M1-6 per §43-45; M1-1 is low-density so towers less applicable

rear.requirement: 20 ft min depth for interior lots per ZR §43-40; 40 ft rear yard equivalent above ground floor for through lots
rear.note: M districts have no front or side yard requirements

manufacturing: Light manufacturing uses subject to performance standards (§42-40 through §42-48)
commercial: Retail and services per Use Group 6-8
residential: M1-1D suffix permits residential with special authorization per §42-311
permitted_uses.adult_establishments: Not permitted within 500 ft of residence district, school, house of worship per §42-51

dob_filing_notes: Manufacturing district — confirm industrial use is allowed at site
Performance standards (noise, vibration, smoke, glare, etc.) must be verified per §42-40 to §42-48
No front or side yard required — site can build to property line
If residential conversion needed: M1-1D suffix required; authorization from CPC or BSA required
DOB: file NB or Alt1. Review if within 500 ft of residential district — adult use restrictions apply
verify_far: true — underlying M1-1 FAR not fixed; check Special Purpose District overlay or applicable zone district
